profile_text.body:
SpaceX describes itself as designing, manufacturing and launching advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. Its website is spacex.com.

The record holds it as a public company trading under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412, headquartered at Starbase, Texas. It also appears under the alias SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A. No lawsuits are listed against it, and its recorded legal exposure sits in Texas, with 126 matters.

No products are listed for the company, and the material on hand describes no AI work.
